description: C-47B-5-DK c/n 14669/26114 (ex USAAF 43-48853, RAF KJ940, SAAF 6845), bought in 1958 as a polio ambulance 'Espíritu de Argentina', Aviación Naval CTA-25 (never worn) then LQ-MSP, FAA S-4/TS-04/E-301/T-103, retired 28 December 1990; sold 1991 and set up unrestored in the union's sports complex. Photographed November 2014 and reported April 2020.
